taskDetailExtra.denialVisibilityTitle: Task is outside this actor's visibility
taskDetailExtra.denialVisibilityDescription: Issue writes are open by default, but only for tasks the actor can already read. {{issue}} is not visible to {{actor}}, so its comment, update, child, and assignment channels are all closed — the wall is visibility, not the write itself.
taskDetailExtra.denialVisibilityWho: {{assignee}}, and any agent or board member the task is visible to.
taskDetailExtra.denialVisibilityPath: Ask the board to widen visibility for {{actor}}, or create a child issue with the request in its description and let its assignee act.
taskDetailExtra.denialActorClassTitle: This actor class cannot write to tasks
taskDetailExtra.denialActorClassDescription: Default-open issue writes are a standard-trust privilege. Low-trust, skill-test, and task-bridge scopes keep their existing tight walls, so {{actor}} cannot write to {{issue}} no matter who it acts for.
taskDetailExtra.denialActorClassWho: A standard-trust agent in this company, or a board member.
taskDetailExtra.denialActorClassPath: Report the request upward and let a standard-trust agent make the write — actor-class scope cannot be widened per task.
taskDetailExtra.denialResponsibleCeilingDescription: This action was denied because {{responsible}} does not have permission to perform it. A run can never exceed the permissions of the user it acts for, so the write to {{issue}} was refused.
taskDetailExtra.denialResponsibleCeilingWho: {{responsible}} once authorized, or anyone already permitted to write to {{issue}}.
taskDetailExtra.denialResponsibleCeilingPath: Grant {{responsible}} the required permission, or have someone who is authorized take this action instead.
taskDetailExtra.denialResponsibleUnavailableDescription: This run acts on behalf of {{responsible}}, but that account was removed or deactivated, so its permissions can no longer be evaluated. The write to {{issue}} was refused for that reason.
taskDetailExtra.denialResponsibleUnavailableWho: A board member, or {{actor}} once it has an active responsible user.
taskDetailExtra.denialResponsibleUnavailablePath: Mark the work blocked and reassign a responsible user (or reactivate the account) before the agent continues.
taskDetailExtra.denialRunLockTitle: Another agent's run owns this task
taskDetailExtra.denialRunLockDescription: {{assignee}} has {{issue}} checked out and a run is live. Checkout and run ownership stay assignee-scoped even though writes are open, so field edits belong to the run that holds the lock until it finishes.
taskDetailExtra.denialRunLockWho: {{assignee}}'s live run, or an agent holding the manage-active-checkouts permission.
taskDetailExtra.denialRunLockPath: Comment instead of patching — comments stay open and wake {{assignee}} — or wait for the run to release the lock and retry.
taskDetailExtra.denialCapTitle: This run has spent its cross-issue write budget
taskDetailExtra.denialCapDescription: A single heartbeat run may make at most {{cap}} cross-issue comments or task updates combined; this was attempt {{count}}. The cap bounds runaway comment sprays and loops — it is a rate backstop, not a permission decision, so {{actor}} is still allowed to write to {{issue}}.
taskDetailExtra.denialCapDescriptionNoAttempt: A single heartbeat run may make at most {{cap}} cross-issue comments or task updates combined. The cap bounds runaway comment sprays and loops — it is a rate backstop, not a permission decision, so {{actor}} is still allowed to write to {{issue}}.
taskDetailExtra.denialCapWho: {{actor}} on its next heartbeat run, or {{assignee}} on {{issue}} directly.
taskDetailExtra.denialCapPath: Consolidate what is left into one comment on your own task, or end the run and continue on the next heartbeat — the budget resets per run.
taskDetailExtra.denialRunContextTitle: Cross-issue writes need a run to attribute them to
taskDetailExtra.denialRunContextDescription: Every agent comment and task update is attributed to a heartbeat run so the cross-issue cap can be counted and the audit trail can name who acted for whom. This request arrived without a valid run, so it could not be contained.
taskDetailExtra.denialRunContextWho: {{actor}}, once the request carries its own run id.
taskDetailExtra.denialRunContextPath: Send the `X-Paperclip-Run-Id` header with your current run (`$PAPERCLIP_RUN_ID`) and retry.
taskDetailExtra.denialAttributionTitle: Responsible user cannot be chosen by the caller
taskDetailExtra.denialAttributionDescription: `onBehalfOfUserId` is derived from the authenticated actor, never from the request body — an agent cannot pick the human whose authority it rides. The attempt was recorded in the audit log.
taskDetailExtra.denialAttributionWho: {{actor}} itself: the write is allowed, only the chosen attribution is not.
taskDetailExtra.denialAttributionPath: Remove `onBehalfOfUserId` from the request and retry; the server fills in {{responsible}} from your run.
